verdict.rationale: Omarchy is a full Linux distribution meant to run directly on hardware, so running inside another host OS is not its main mode. One doc item does say all of Omarchy can run in a virtual machine 'so you can get a taste first' [omarchy-docs-40], and once running it provides a rich terminal and dev-tooling environment (Foot, Alacritty, Ghostty and Kitty terminals; mise-managed dev environments) [omarchy-docs-36][omarchy-docs-35]. The Windows-in-Docker VM goes the opposite direction (Windows inside Linux) and does not count here. Missing for 10: documentation of VM-hosted Omarchy as a supported dev workflow, setup instructions for specific host OSes (macOS/Windows), host-guest file/tooling integration, and independent hands-on corroboration.
